title: Add room and scene API functions to React client
description:
Modify react_ui/src/api/client.ts to add TypeScript fetch functions for all room, scene, and roleplay API endpoints.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts (existing API client — understand base URL configuration, fetch wrapper patterns, TypeScript type/interface conventions, error handling)
- chatbot/api/rooms.py (created by task b.7 — understand exact endpoint paths, request bodies, and response shapes)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY react_ui/src/api/client.ts. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Open react_ui/src/api/client.ts and inspect the existing API function patterns: base URL, fetch wrapper, TypeScript type conventions (interface vs type, naming convention), error handling.

2. Add TypeScript types/interfaces matching the Python Pydantic models:
   - RoomType: 'one_on_one_chat' | 'roleplay_scene' | 'project' | 'emotional_support' | 'memory_review'
   - RoomMemoryPolicy: persist_to_durable (boolean), scope ('room' | 'companion' | 'global'), max_context_turns (number), include_embeddings (boolean)
   - RoomData: room_id (string), user_id (string), companion_id (string | null), room_type (RoomType), display_name (string), memory_policy (RoomMemoryPolicy), scene_id (string | null), created_at (string)
   - RoomCreateParams: user_id (string), room_type (RoomType), display_name (string | undefined), companion_id (string | undefined)
   - MemoryPolicyUpdateParams: persist_to_durable (boolean | undefined), scope (string | undefined), max_context_turns (number | undefined), include_embeddings (boolean | undefined)
   - SceneData: all SceneState fields (scene_id, room_id, location, activity, tone, intensity, is_paused, started_at, paused_at, resumed_at, ended_at, participants, scene_context)
   - SceneCreateParams: room_id (string), location (string), activity (string)
   - SceneUpdateParams: location (string | undefined), activity (string | undefined), tone (string | undefined), intensity (number | undefined), scene_context (string | undefined), participants (string[] | undefined)
   - PersonaParams: name (string), description (string), traits (string[]), voice_style (string), backstory (string), scene_goals (string[]), constraints (string[])
   - ScenePromptResponse: system_prompt (string)
   - ClassificationResponse: classification ('scene_only' | 'durable' | 'both')

3. Add async fetch functions:
   - createRoom(params: RoomCreateParams): Promise<RoomData>
   - listRooms(userId: string): Promise<RoomData[]>
   - getRoom(roomId: string): Promise<RoomData>
   - updateRoomMemoryPolicy(roomId: string, params: MemoryPolicyUpdateParams): Promise<RoomData>
   - deleteRoom(roomId: string): Promise<void>
   - createScene(roomId: string, params: SceneCreateParams): Promise<SceneData>
   - getActiveScene(roomId: string): Promise<SceneData>
   - getScene(sceneId: string): Promise<SceneData>
   - updateScene(sceneId: string, params: SceneUpdateParams): Promise<SceneData>
   - pauseScene(sceneId: string): Promise<SceneData>
   - resumeScene(sceneId: string): Promise<SceneData>
   - endScene(sceneId: string): Promise<SceneData>
   - setScenePersona(sceneId: string, params: PersonaParams): Promise<ScenePromptResponse>
   - classifySceneMemory(sceneId: string, text: string): Promise<ClassificationResponse>

4. All new functions use the existing fetch wrapper and base URL pattern.
